categories.main_business_segments: Sinher Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of hinge components and metal structural products. Its main products are hinge components used mainly in notebook computers, with applications also in POS systems, AIOs, and projectors. The company is expanding into diversified product lines including server hinges, automotive hinges, and industrial computer components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including metal injection molding (MIM), stamping, machining, die casting, and sintering processes. It has integrated automation and robotic equipment to enhance production efficiency and quality consistency. R&D focuses on innovative hinge designs such as ultra-thin, multi-axis folding, hidden hinges, and foldable screen hinges, meeting market demands for lightweight and stable products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sinher serves primarily notebook computer manufacturers and brand owners such as HP, Dell, Acer, Asus, Lenovo, and Fujitsu. Its products are also used in consumer electronics like tablets and industrial devices. The company targets global OEMs and ODMs in the consumer electronics and computing sectors, with a focus on high-end and AI-enabled notebook markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and Greater China, with manufacturing facilities in New Taipei City, Keelung, China, Vietnam, and Thailand. It actively expands its overseas presence, especially in Southeast Asia, to diversify geographic risks and support global supply chains. Its sales are concentrated in the Asia-Pacific region, with growing penetration in Europe and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sinher is positioned primarily in the upstream to midstream segments of the notebook computer supply chain. It manufactures critical hinge components and subassemblies, sourcing raw materials like steel sheets, zinc/aluminum ingots, and metal powders from upstream suppliers. It supplies these components to system integrators and notebook manufacturers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes precision supply chain cost and quality control, advancing automation in production lines, and expanding diversified product offerings. R&D priorities include developing innovative hinge structures for foldable and dual-screen devices, enhancing thinness and stability, and promoting MIM product lines. It also focuses on intellectual property protection and sustainable manufacturing practices.
categories.revenue_model: Sinher generates revenue primarily through product sales of hinge components and metal parts to notebook manufacturers and related electronics OEMs. Revenue is based on volume shipments and contract manufacturing agreements. The company also invests in expanding product lines to capture new market segments beyond notebooks.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include companies like Shin-Ei, Chia Hsin, Lian Hong, and Fushida, all holding significant market shares in the notebook hinge industry. Sinher maintains a competitive position through vertical integration, strong R&D capabilities, and automation to control costs and quality. It aims to differentiate by innovation and expanding into niche hinge applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sinher reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$1.96 billion, a 2.54% increase from the previous year, with a net profit of NT$71 million, significantly improving profitability. The company invests around 4-5% of revenues in R&D and plans continued growth of 3-8% in sales volume. Assets total about NT$4.07 billion with steady equity growth and manageable liabilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sinher offers high-precision, innovative hinge solutions that meet evolving market demands for lightweight, thin, and multifunctional notebook designs. Its vertical integration and automation enable cost control and quality stability, providing reliable supply to global brand customers. The company’s focus on R&D and patent protection supports differentiated products like foldable hinges, enhancing customer value and competitive advantage.
